brief.headline: Ask for ₹290.00/KG to match our best price; supplier is loss-making so lead with faster payment for a discount, and line up Huhtamaki or UFLEX as a second source.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹290.00/KG on the main laminates (currently ₹295.00/KG)
priceAsk.basis: Shrinath Roto Pack Pvt Ltd already gives us ₹290.00/KG for the same items; market asking price for this type of laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our current ₹295.00/KG sits at the top of the fair band — room to come down to ₹290.00/KG without leaving fair territory

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (instead of 30) in exchange for a price cut of roughly 11%
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹9.49 L of cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: They lost money in FY2024-25 (kept -3.4% of every ₹100 they sold vs 2.5% for similar firms) and scored only 2/10 on money-health. They owe 2.15x their own cash and their credit rating is IVR BBB- / Stable. They borrow money at about 10.96%, so paying them 15 days early is worth roughly that rate to them. Our ₹2.31 Cr spend is just 0.33% of their ₹691.05 Cr revenue — we're tiny to them — but the loss and the debt mean cash is tight, so they'll value faster payment. Don't squeeze hard on price alone or you risk tipping a fragile supplier; use the payment-speed lever and keep a backup ready.

evidence.point: We pay ₹295.00/KG; Shrinath gives us ₹290.00/KG for the same sachets
Market asking price for pharma ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — verdict MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)
They lost money last year and keep far less profit than rivals
They already take longer to pay their own suppliers than similar firms do
They borrow money at about 10.96%, so paying them 15 days early is worth roughly that rate to them
Paying them 15 days faster would free up cash for us

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (revenue ₹2758.00 Cr, health C 59/100)

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source at scale (revenue ₹16492.00 Cr, health C 46/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister and sachet laminates; strong second-source (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100)

risks: They lost ₹-23.68 Cr in FY2024-25 and scored 2/10 on money-health — pushing too hard on price could break supply; lead with faster payment and keep a backup ready
Five red flags: loss-making, severe legal case(s), GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, high debt (2.15x) — don't put all your volume through them
Their Altman Z-score is 1.68 (grey zone) — not in immediate distress, but vulnerable; a gentle push on payment terms is safer than a hard price squeeze
We're only 0.33% of their revenue — we have almost no customer leverage, so the ask must rest on matching our best price and offering faster payment, not on volume
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to match the ₹290.00/KG that Shrinath gives us for these laminates — and if you need cash faster, we can pay in 15 days instead of 30 for a discount of roughly your borrowing rate.
